notable_absence.finding: This page's own intro states its scope precisely: 'This table identifies the RBAC roles required by Sync Gateway to execute endpoint actions.' Every one of Table 1's ~50 endpoint rows, Table 2's ~19 common-endpoint rows, and Table 3's single metrics row names an explicit Couchbase Server RBAC role (or role set) as the gate - there is no row anywhere on this page, and no endpoint in either reference cross-index, gated by anything other than a named role: concept. Given this batch's central hypothesis (whether the REST API surface itself would show a Server/Capella-style RBAC check contradicting round 27's channel-based, no-requiresPrivilege sync-function model), the finding is: YES, a Server-RBAC-role gate exists here, but it does not contradict round 27 - it operates one layer up, on the Admin/Metrics REST API's own request authorization (already captured generally by the promoted sgw:rbac-user concept and requiresServerRole predicate), never on the document-level channel-based read/write model round 27 examined. This page is simply the first with the endpoint-by-endpoint granularity to state that outer layer's role requirements exhaustively rather than as a general assertion.

cross_component_finding: This page did not extract every one of its ~70 endpoint-role rows individually (would be excessive relative to the marginal ontology value - all rows draw from the same small, now-fully-minted role vocabulary of role:cluster-admin/role:full-administrator/role:ro-admin/role:bucket-admin/role:bucket-application-access/role:sync-gateway-role/role:sync-gateway-architect/role:sync-gateway-application/role:sync-gateway-application-read-only/role:sync-gateway-replicator/role:sync-gateway-dev-ops/role:external-stats-reader); a representative sample tied to already-registered sgw: operation/entity concepts (user, role, database, import-filter, compact, resync, ISGR, metrics) was extracted instead. A coordinator wanting full endpoint-level coverage would need a dedicated pass over this table rather than treating it as ordinary extraction content.
cross_product_finding: The pre-7.0.2 column of every table on this page uses ONLY generic Server roles (Cluster Admin, Full Admin, Read Only Admin, Sync Gateway Role, Bucket Admin, Bucket Application Access) while the 7.0.2+ column swaps in Sync-Gateway-specific roles (Architect/Application/Application Read Only/Replicator/Dev Ops/External Stats Reader) for nearly every endpoint - a clean product-level illustration of Couchbase Server's RBAC catalogue being extended specifically to give Sync Gateway administration finer-grained roles, the same general pattern (a product driving new entries into Server's shared role catalogue) already seen for the Backup Service (role:backup-admin) and Eventing (role:eventing-full-admin).
